stem: The social platform reports a CPA of €8 and paid search reports a CPA of €32. The social platform counts newsletter sign-ups as conversions; paid search counts orders. What can the team conclude?

options.text: Social wins customers four times more cheaply and should get more budget
Paid search is better, since a higher CPA means each of its conversions is worth more
Nothing yet, since the two CPAs count different conversions and do not compare
Social is cheaper per order, provided both CPAs cover the same month
